abstract: A 35-year-old man visited a local doctor for continuing analysis of his infertility. Semen analysis revealed azoospermia while an ultrasonography detected a right testicular tumor with a diameter of 10 mm. A blood test was negative for tumor markers. Magnetic resonance imaging showed a 1-cm tumor in the right testis and atrophy of the left testis. A testicular tumor arising from a functional unilateral testis was discovered during infertility treatment for which the patient was referred to our hospital for fertility preservation. Right and left testicular volumes were 18 mL and 3 mL, respectively, and his serum testosterone level was 2.96 ng/mL. Noting the atrophy of the contralateral testicle, we proceeded with a rapid pathology diagnosis by partial testicular resection. If no evidence of tumor malignancy was found, the surgery would have been concluded with no further dissection. Since the patient was undergoing fertility treatment, the decision was made to take sperm from the extracted testicle to preserve his fertility, followed by orchiectomy. Because a seminoma was suspected through the rapid pathological diagnosis, the man eventually underwent higher orchiectomy and testicular sperm extraction. The final diagnosis was seminoma, followed by successful retrieval of a sufficient level of sperm. Post operative serum testosterone level was found to be 0.32 ng/mL, after which testosterone replacement therapy was introduced. Through rapid diagnosis of pathology, successful management and outcome were achieved in the case of testicular cancer combined with infertility.
abstract_ja: 不妊症の継続的な分析のため地域医で受診した35歳男性。精液検査で無精子症を認め、超音波検査で直径10mmの右精巣腫瘍を検出した。血液検査では腫瘍マーカーは陰性であった。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)は右精巣の1cm腫瘍と左精巣の萎縮を示した。機能的な一側精巣からの精巣腫瘍は不妊治療中に発見され、生殖能力の保存のため当院に紹介された。右および左精巣容積はそれぞれ18mLおよび3mLであり、血清テストステロン値は2.96 ng/mLであった。対側精巣の萎縮に注目して、部分精巣切除による迅速病理診断を実施した。腫瘍の悪性所見がなければ、手術は追加の切除なく終了する予定であった。患者が不妊治療を受けていたため、生殖能力保存のため抽出精巣から精子を採取することを決定し、その後精巣摘除術を実施した。迅速病理診断でセミノーマが疑われたため、最終的に高位精巣摘除術と精巣精子採取が実施された。最終診断はセミノーマであり、その後十分なレベルの精子採取に成功した。術後血清テストステロン値は0.32 ng/mLであり、その後テストステロン補充療法が導入された。迅速な病理診断を通じて、不妊症を伴う精巣がんの症例において成功した管理および転帰が達成された。
